stages.name: ideation
stages.description: Generates creative ideas, possibilities, and initial solutions without heavy judgment. Focused on exploration and breadth.

stages.name: evaluation
stages.description: Evaluates ideas for weaknesses, risks, and logical flaws. Focused on accuracy, feasibility, and improvement.

stages.name: synthesis
stages.description: Combines the best ideas and feedback into a coherent, refined outcome. Focused on integration and clarity.
